name: battle-win-only-opposing-destroyed
about: v0.55: (When Battles) 'When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP' = trigger BATTLE_WIN (Standard Comprehensive Rules 8-1-6-2). The player's The Witch Naja (BS01-047, 1 core, 3000 BP) attacks Goradons (1000 BP); when only the blocker is destroyed it exhausts the other opposing Spirit. On a tie (both destroyed) it does not activate.
